Package index

Population moments

Divide by N rather than N - 1. A schedule of potential outcomes is a population, not a sample from one.

pop_var()
Population variance
pop_cov()
Population covariance
pop_sd()
Population standard deviation

Standard errors and tests

The true standard error, which needs the potential outcomes no experiment reveals, and the indirect test for effect heterogeneity.

equation_3.4()
The true standard error of a two-arm experiment under complete random assignment
difference_in_variances()
Test for a difference in outcome variances between treatment arms

Simulations

Bayesian updating from an experimental result, and a simulated research literature in which studies arrive in a random order.

posterior_mean_fn()
Compute the Bayesian posterior mean given a normal prior and experimental result
simulate_posteriors()
Simulate Bayesian posterior distributions across experimental sample sizes
make_studies()
Simulate a research literature with a gender-composition moderator
